Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines + SCCs questions — internal triage

Team — quick internal triage and recommended positions. I reviewed the attached ClearWave redlines. Summary and proposed path:

1) Processor/Controller statements (Sections 2 & 5):
   - Position: maintain Redwood's current processor description but add a concise statement confirming we process on customer's instructions and that control choices remain with customer. Do NOT accept controller liability language.
   - Rationale: preserves product model and avoids open-ended indemnity.

2) SCCs fallback routing:
   - Position: provide an SCCs execution commitment (we will execute the appropriate clause set) and add an operational routing annex describing fallback model:
     a) Preferred: route to EU-hosted capacity (no SCCs change).
     b) Fallback: where EU routing not available, we rely on SCCs + TIA safeguards with documented subprocessor list and additional technical safeguards (encryption at rest, KMS control).
   - Ask to engineering/procurement for confirmation of achievable routing annex details and timeline.

3) Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA):
   - We can accept the TIA as a living annex but must limit operational guarantees to network/hosting routing and technical controls; avoid SLA-like promises about availability of specific regions.

4) Evidence & attachments: procurement will produce a subprocessor list and SOC2 scope. Ben — can you produce the latest subprocessor inventory and a one-page KMS architecture statement by 12/05?

5) Timeline / legal gate:
   - We can aim for internal legal gate on 2026-12-07 (EOD Pacific) to consolidate language and prepare a DocuSign bundle on 12/08 for counterparty review.

Attachments: I prepared a redline summary (inline comments) and a short fallback annex draft (see attached files in drive).

Action items:
- Ben Carter: subprocessor inventory + KMS one-pager (due 12/05).
- Karthik: review and propose line edits for Section 5 liability carveouts and confirm acceptable alternative language for controller/processor representation (due 12/06).
- Jonas: prep negotiation notes for the GC call on 12/07.

I'll draft the fallback annex and circulate for quick legal sign-off.

Laura Bennett
